mapper.select: select g.name,sum(go.num) as value from goods as g inner join goods_order as go on go.goods_id=g.goods_id group by g.goods_id order by value desc limit 3
select ma.card_type AS name,COUNT(ma.apply_id) as value from member_apply as ma GROUP BY ma.card_type,ma.card_day order by value desc limit 3
select c.course_name as name,COUNT(mc.member_course_id) as value from course as c left join member_course as mc on mc.course_id=c.course_id group by c.course_id order by value desc limit 3
